summary.text: Mary Insprucker is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Julie von Haefen (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described her background as a former regional director for a nonprofit, a government consultant and a substitute teacher.

paragraphs.text: Insprucker said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that her experience includes serving on the board of directors of the American Red Cross and extensive community involvement.

She listed three key messages for her campaign: restoring affordable living, tax reduction guardrails such as caps on tax levies and review of re-evaluation frequency, and safety in schools and homes supported by a robust police force.
She also named education as a priority, saying teachers should be paid appropriately and given supplies and that teacher-student ratios should be reduced.
